categories.main_business_segments: Beijing Bayi Space LCD Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of display materials, semiconductor materials, and pharmaceutical materials. Its main business focuses on liquid crystal display materials, including liquid crystal materials, polymer dispersed liquid crystal (PDLC) smart films, and organic electroluminescent materials (OLED). The company also develops semiconductor materials such as photoresist resin and polyimide (PSPI) materials, as well as advanced pharmaceutical intermediates and raw materials.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses core technologies in molecular design and simulation of liquid crystals, low-temperature reaction technology, novel catalyst coupling reactions, hydrogenation, short-path molecular distillation, column chromatography, high vacuum distillation, trace impurity analysis and control, and mixed liquid crystal formulation and production control. It also has proprietary technologies in high vacuum sublimation for OLED materials and polymerization control for semiconductor photoresist resins. Production is managed through advanced systems including NC ERP, MES, and QEHS quality management systems to ensure efficient, high-quality manufacturing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major LCD panel manufacturers such as BOE Technology Group, HKC Corporation, and Innolux Corporation. The company serves industries producing smartphones, notebooks, monitors, televisions, and automotive displays. It also targets semiconductor manufacturers for photoresist materials and pharmaceutical companies for advanced intermediates and raw materials. The automotive sector, especially the growing new energy vehicle market, is a significant end market for its display materials.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Beijing and production bases in Zhejiang and Hebei provinces. It has subsidiaries in Shanghai, Hong Kong, Japan, and Zimbabwe, reflecting an expanding international footprint. The company is actively developing overseas markets, particularly for OLED materials and automotive display applications.
categories.supply_chain_position: Bayi Space operates primarily upstream and midstream in the supply chain as a producer of core electronic materials such as liquid crystal compounds, photoresist resins, and pharmaceutical intermediates. It supplies these specialized materials to downstream panel manufacturers, semiconductor fabs, and pharmaceutical producers, positioning itself as a critical materials platform provider within the electronic materials ecosystem.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes technology-driven market development with a focus on independent R&D and innovation. Strategic R&D priorities include high-performance TFT liquid crystal materials, OLED materials, advanced photoresist resins, PSPI materials, and pharmaceutical intermediates. It invests heavily in developing new products aligned with emerging display technologies such as Mini/Micro LED and automotive displays, as well as semiconductor advanced process materials. The company also focuses on digital transformation and intelligent manufacturing to enhance production efficiency.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of customized electronic materials including mixed liquid crystals, liquid crystal monomers, OLED materials, photoresist resins, and pharmaceutical intermediates. Sales are mostly direct to large panel manufacturers and semiconductor companies, with some sales through distributors. The company also earns investment income from strategic equity holdings and financial asset management.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Bayi Space is one of the leading domestic suppliers of liquid crystal display materials in China, recognized as a strategic supplier to major panel makers like BOE. It is among the top three domestic companies with core independent intellectual property in TFT mixed liquid crystals, breaking foreign monopolies. The company is also a significant player in the domestic photoresist resin market, competing with foreign incumbents by leveraging local industry growth and government support. Its diversified product portfolio and strong R&D capabilities position it as a key electronic materials platform enterprise.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 737 million, a 7.77% decrease from the previous year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 76.6 million, down 28.27%. Total assets reached RMB 2.9 billion with steady growth in fixed assets and R&D investment, which accounted for nearly 12% of revenue. Despite short-term revenue decline due to market pressures, the company maintains a solid financial base and continues to invest in capacity expansion and innovation for long-term growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Bayi Space emphasizes high-quality, high-performance, and technologically advanced electronic materials with strong customization capabilities tailored to customer needs. Its proprietary molecular design and production technologies enable superior product stability, reliability, and performance, particularly in TFT liquid crystal materials and photoresist resins. The company’s integrated R&D and production platform, combined with close collaboration with leading panel manufacturers, ensures timely innovation and supply chain security. Its commitment to independent intellectual property and localized supply reduces reliance on foreign suppliers, offering customers competitive cost and supply advantages.
